pack.name: roman-memory
pack.description: Phase 53j memory hygiene for janus, minerva and vesta: the state-like predicates the Romans write through memory_write are single-valued and temporal (the newest value supersedes, older values are history), and the spellings the models produced are declared aliases. Chosen from the 2026-09-24 store: each predicate here had subjects holding several live values that were successive updates of one state (e.g. next_check: 478 live triples on 230 subjects, 53 subjects with 2-46 values, three spellings plus has_next_check).

relations.name: next_check
relations.description: When or what the akh checks next. 478 live triples, 230 subjects, 53 multi-valued (max 46).

relations.name: next_action
relations.description: The akh's committed next step for a subject. 61 live, 37 subjects, 6 multi-valued (max 9).

relations.name: planned_action
relations.description: The currently planned action. 28 live, 21 subjects, 3 multi-valued (max 4).

relations.name: current_phase
relations.description: Observed work-item phase. 31 live, 24 subjects, 4 multi-valued (max 4).

relations.name: current_state
relations.description: Observed current state. 12 live, 8 subjects, 3 multi-valued (max 3).

relations.name: has_state
relations.description: State of an alert or work item. 62 live, 57 subjects, 3 multi-valued (max 3).

relations.name: observed_state
relations.description: State seen at the latest wake. 16 live, 10 subjects, 1 multi-valued (max 7).

relations.name: verified_state
relations.description: State verified at the latest check. 21 live, 16 subjects, 3 multi-valued (max 3).

relations.name: boundary_state
relations.description: Merge-boundary state of a work item. 9 live on 1 subject, all successive updates.

relations.name: status
relations.description: Alert / session status (e.g. active -> resolved). 44 live, 40 subjects, 4 multi-valued (max 2).
